title: Grateful Dead Live at Bellarmine College on 1968-12-07

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard recording with noticeable hiss and cuts, but a historic 12‑7‑68 show highlighted by the rare Rosemary and stellar New Potato/Caboose jams.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a raw 1968 performance that many fans cherish for its rarity – especially the low‑key live rendition of “Rosemary” and the soaring New Potato (Caboose) jam. While the soundboard source is generally clear, listeners repeatedly note hiss, partial cuts and sloppy editing that detract from an otherwise exciting set featuring Dark Star, a powerful “That’s It for The Other One” suite and a memorable Morning Dew > Bid You Goodnight transition.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, the majority give 4‑5 stars and praise the musical moments despite consistent complaints about hiss and editing; this yields a strong positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard capture but plagued by tape hiss, noticeable partial cuts (especially at the start), and uneven editing that leaves some sections chopped or out of order.

standout_songs: "That’s It For The Other One" suite
poor_songs: Morning Dew (noted as weak by some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its exploratory, psychedelic vibe typical of ’68, with an intense Other One suite and strong jams, though a few reviewers find the middle section too mellow and note occasional sloppiness due to cuts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for stellar, blazing guitar work, inventive volume‑knob dynamics, and delivering the rare Rosemary performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned for his “thunder” bass and a classical‑turn feel during the Other One jam; praised by several reviewers.
